en-US.title: FollowNet VPN
en-US.subtitle: Fast private iOS VPN
en-US.promotionalText: Try Free with weekly traffic — Premium for unlimited. WireGuard, VLESS Reality, Smart Connect.
en-US.description:
FollowNet VPN — a focused VPN for iPhone and iPad.

CONNECT IN ONE TAP
Smart Connect picks among WireGuard, AmneziaWG, Hysteria2, VLESS Reality, and IKEv2 when networks fight classic tunnels.

FREE VS PREMIUM
Free includes a weekly traffic allowance so you can test a real tunnel. Premium unlocks unlimited traffic, premium locations shown in the app, and up to 5 devices.

BUILT FOR iOS
Auto-connect, DNS profiles, Network Profiles, Speed Test, widgets, and Shortcuts. Sign in with an email code — no password to forget.

CHROME ON DESKTOP
Same account, browser proxy in Chrome (not a full-device desktop VPN).

Honest product: no fake audit badges, no “unlimited free forever.”

Support: support@follow-net.com
Privacy: https://follow-net.com/privacy
